issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk: the problem statement UML and textual description (problem_statement.md) and the example usage in the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnMilk() that returns a String like "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". The solution repository defines the interface method as messageOnMilk(double volume) and the concrete classes Seal and Goat implement the version with a double parameter. This parameter-list mismatch will cause compilation or test failures for students who implement/compile against the problem/template specification and prevents a direct, unambiguous mapping between the exercise description and the provided solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across all artifacts. Preferred option (keeps exercise text/UML/template unchanged): change the solution to declare messageOnMilk() with no parameters in Milkable, and update Seal and Goat to implement public String messageOnMilk() returning the exact format described in the problem (e.g., "Seal Clarabelle is milked"). Alternative option: update the problem statement, UML, and template Main to require messageOnMilk(double volume) everywhere and document how the volume is used in the returned string. Ensure all example usages (Main.java) and tests are updated to match the chosen signature.
